# Evaluation and Acceptance

Capture baseline routing, behavior, security, failure, context, performance, and portability evidence. Map each original invariant and eval to the new topology.

Test direct and paraphrased positive triggers, neighboring negatives, compound requests, permission boundaries, partial failure, resource links, scripts, consumers, facade behavior, and rollback. Use comparable models, tools, fixtures, and hosts. New structure without comparable behavioral evidence is inconclusive.
